channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Amid shifting attitudes toward immigrants, disinformation unsettles Vietnamese in Japan
item.description: As Japan tightens its visa rules, some Vietnamese say their community has become a target of anti-immigration disinformation.

item.title: Olympic Council of Asia touts Asian Games as success despite logistical issues
item.description: OCA Director General Husain Al-Musallam said that at a time when the Games must be sustainable and financially viable, the Aichi-Nagoya model was one worth copying.

item.title: As wind power momentum slows in Japan, can tech help the industry get back on track?
item.description: Concerns from environmentalists have played a role in the slow buildup of Japan's offshore wind industry. The latest tech could provide a solution.

item.title: Japan needs to protect its undersea lifelines
item.description: Japan's security rests not only on the ships and aircraft patrolling its waters and skies, but also the invisible network resting on the ocean floor.

item.title: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs wins election held under shadow of Ukraine war
item.description: Baltic countries have warned for months that Russia is mounting sabotage, cyber and other hybrid attacks across Europe to erode support for Ukraine.

item.title: Japanese anime event opens in New Delhi, attracting India’s youth
item.description: The event features booths of many anime-related companies, including major Japanese publisher Kodansha, best known for the popular manga series "Attack on Titan."

item.title: Japan delivers ‘strong protest’ to U.S. after marine arrested in Okinawa robbery-murder
item.description: The 20-year-old suspect, who has denied the charges, is suspected of killing a woman and stealing her backpack and wallet at a hotel in Naha.

item.title: Japan sets record with 83 gold medals at Asian Games
item.description: The total surpassed the previous record of 78 gold medals won by Japan at the 1966 Bangkok Games.

item.title: ‘Sando: The Art of the Japanese Sandwich’ elevates the humble bite
item.description: Paris-based chef Walter Ishizuka's new book uplifts classic recipes with entirely achievable fine-dining flourishes.

item.title: The man who gave tequila a shot in Japan
item.description: A meeting with Sean Connery set Ikuma Hayashi on the path to being an evangelist for Mexico's favorite spirit.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.

item.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
item.description: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

item.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
item.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.
